_comment: Pinned Salesforce IDs for the Hermes v1 golden path.
Verified live against sandbox lvt--partial (org 00DVE00000AUWRJ2A5) on 2026-08-04.
A sandbox refresh may invalidate every ID in this file. Re-verify with tools/verify_pins.py.
Options are pinned BY ID, never by name: several SBQQ__ProductOption__c rows under this
bundle share identical OptionalSKU names (e.g. SBQQ__Number__c 20 appears twice).

bundle.name: MSU + Wall Mounts
bundle._note: Bundle head, BASEUNIT and HEADUNIT all list at $0. All recurring value sits on FORM FACTOR SUBSCRIPTION and MODULE lines.

mobile_with_generator.name: Mobile Mounting Structure - Solar - SMART GENERATOR - White

form_factor_subscriptions._note: Matrix of {MSU, MSU Fuel Cell, Wall/Pole, Wall Extended, GuardGate} x {LVT Managed, Customer Owned, SW Subscription, Service Plan}. v1 uses LVT Managed because the portal models a monthly lease. CPQ admin should confirm this is the right commercial model.

head_units._note: 18 of 59 HEADUNIT options are NDAA. Axis hardware is NDAA-compliant, Dahua is not, which is what the portal's ndaa_compliant toggle actually selects between.

software_modules._note: Keyed by the portal's DISPLAY NAME, not its internal id. Portal ids are misleading: 'alert-management' displays as 'Intelligent Investigations', and a separate legacy 'Alert Management' module also exists in CPQ.

unmappable_portal_options._note: Portal fields with no CPQ counterpart. They are carried in the payload for the rep but produce no quote lines. Do not silently invent lines for these.
unmappable_portal_options.night_vision: IR/thermal capability is inherent to the HEADUNIT choice; there is no separate night-vision SKU or $175 uplift.
unmappable_portal_options.generator_surcharge: Handled by selecting the SMART GENERATOR base unit, not a $1000 add-on line.
unmappable_portal_options.ndaa_surcharge: Handled by HEADUNIT selection (Axis vs Dahua), not a $125 add-on line.

golden_path._note: Verified resolvable pair that traverses Location_Account_UUID_Mapping__c. Most mapping rows in this sandbox do NOT resolve to Accounts; this pair does.
